pyq_bad.why: suspect key: most volatile flow is Foreign Portfolio Investment (option 3), 'Both' is meaningless
wrong topic: China's Belt and Road Initiative

patterns: APPSC asks sector caps as single facts (multi-brand retail 51%, insurance cap in a named Budget) and prohibited sectors (chit funds).
Classification items: ADR/GDR capital, forms of foreign capital (FDI, trade credit, NRI deposits, ECBs), FDI vs FII difference.
Recurring UPSC-style traps: FDI is non-debt creating; portfolio investment is not FDI; P-Notes issued by registered FPIs.
Source-country questions (Mauritius/Singapore top source) and sector with highest inflows (services/telecom) recur.
App MCQs lean on 2025-26 data (gross vs net FDI, PN3 2026 amendment, e-commerce relaxation); FTAs/CEPAs in the title are barely covered by either notes or MCQs.
